title: Latest F1 News
description: Don't miss a Formula 1 moment – with the latest news, videos, standings and results. Go behind the scenes and get analysis straight from the paddock.

items.title: All the key moments from the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix
items.content: Azerbaijan marked 10 years on the F1 calendar with another action-packed weekend of competition – one that saw George Russell emerge victorious and cut team mate Kimi Antonelli’s advantage at the top of the championship.
items.contentSnippet: Azerbaijan marked 10 years on the F1 calendar with another action-packed weekend of competition – one that saw George Russell emerge victorious and cut team mate Kimi Antonelli’s advantage at the top of the championship.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 2026阿塞拜疆大奖赛落下帷幕，比赛过程激烈。乔治·拉塞尔夺冠，并在车手积分榜上缩小了与队友基米·阿隆索的差距。阿塞拜疆站是F1历年的重要赛事，今年正值该站回归赛历十周年。
summaries.en: The 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix celebrated 10 years on the F1 calendar with intense competition. George Russell won the race, reducing Kimi Antonelli's championship lead. The event featured exciting moments and was a significant milestone for the series.

items.summary: 2026阿塞拜疆大奖赛落下帷幕，比赛过程激烈。乔治·拉塞尔夺冠，并在车手积分榜上缩小了与队友基米·阿隆索的差距。阿塞拜疆站是F1历年的重要赛事，今年正值该站回归赛历十周年。

items.title: Azerbaijan mistake 'certainly took me by surprise' – Piastri
items.content: Oscar Piastri admits that the lock-up which potentially cost the Australian driver a podium in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix "certainly took me by surprise", on a day where McLaren failed to score a point.
items.contentSnippet: Oscar Piastri admits that the lock-up which potentially cost the Australian driver a podium in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix "certainly took me by surprise", on a day where McLaren failed to score a point.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里承认，阿塞拜疆大奖赛中导致他可能错失领奖台的锁止情况“确实让我感到意外”，当日梅赛德斯未能获得积分。
summaries.en: Oscar Piastri acknowledges that a lock-up during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix "certainly took me by surprise," which likely cost him a podium finish. McLaren failed to score any points in the race.

items.title: Colapinto gets 5-place grid drop for Bahrain GP in Malaysia
items.content: Franco Colapinto has been given a five-place grid penalty for next weekend’s Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia after causing a multi-car incident at the Baku City Circuit on Saturday.
items.contentSnippet: Franco Colapinto has been given a five-place grid penalty for next weekend’s Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia after causing a multi-car incident at the Baku City Circuit on Saturday.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 弗朗哥·科拉平托因在巴库城市赛道上周六引发多车事故，已被处以下一场马来西亚巴林大奖赛五格发车处罚。
summaries.en: Franco Colapinto received a five-place grid penalty for the Bahrain Grand Prix following a multi-car incident at the Baku City Circuit. The penalty will result in his car starting from a lower position in the race.

items.title: Hadjar hails ‘first proper podium’ with P3 in Baku
items.content: Isack Hadjar was all smiles after completing his comeback from a “very long six weeks” on the sidelines with a podium finish at the Baku City Circuit.
items.contentSnippet: Isack Hadjar was all smiles after completing his comeback from a “very long six weeks” on the sidelines with a podium finish at the Baku City Circuit.

summaries.zh: 哈吉尔在巴库城市赛道上以领奖台成绩完成复出，结束了长达六周的伤病。他在赛后欣喜若狂，这是他首次获得正式领奖台成绩。
summaries.en: Isack Hadjar achieved a podium finish at the Baku City Circuit after recovering from a six-week injury. This marked his successful return to competition, with the result described as his "first proper podium."

items.title: Verstappen 'was trying everything' in quest for Baku victory
items.content: Max Verstappen admits he "was trying everything" to claim victory in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the Red Bull driver eventually falling short by just one-tenth against George Russell.
items.contentSnippet: Max Verstappen admits he "was trying everything" to claim victory in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the Red Bull driver eventually falling short by just one-tenth against George Russell.

summaries.en: Max Verstappen says he "was trying everything" to win the Azerbaijan Grand Prix but finished second, just one-tenth behind George Russell.

items.content: Kimi Antonelli made clear that the Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend “taught me a lot” after enduring his “worst weekend of the season” on Baku’s streets.

summaries.en: Kimi Antonelli described the Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend as his "worst of the season" but stated it was a valuable learning experience, as it taught him a lot on Baku's streets.

items.content: Lando Norris was on course for valuable points before a crash with the Alpine's Franco Colapinto and Pierre Gasly forced him to retire from the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
